name: lrc_lfe2
character: Project layout 3.2: left, right and centre at ear level with two low-frequency channels (LFE1 left, LFE2 right). Not a broadcast standard.
sources: ITU-R BS.775-3: front loudspeakers at -30, 0 and +30 degrees; centre folded into both channels at 0.7071 (-3 dB). Nominal values; this is a project-defined layout, not a BS.2051 system
Low-frequency block, reverb return spread and gate windows are copied from the 5.1 layout of this engine (itu_bs2051_system_b) and are starting values: none has been measured on a three-front room
knowledgebase/sound-design/layout-3-2.md: two low-frequency channels, what is and is not a standard

decorrelate_above_hz 40 Hz and the all-pass cascade (4 stages, 3 ms total group delay: about 86 degrees of phase at 80 Hz, so the channels never approach antiphase inside the band) are starting values, not measured in a room
gate.decode_uniformity_max_db: measured on the 5th-order sphere (400 points): allrad2 0.34 dB, allrad 3.26 dB for this front-only layout; the declared limits add margin (starting values)
qa.listening_room: a 5 x 4 x 2.5 m box, RT60 0.5 s, subs in opposite floor corners, is a starting value for a virtual room, not a measured one; the row that uses it is advisory
